name: Muscadine Grape U-Pick Farms
description: A small u-pick farm in Winnsboro, TX, Muscadine Grape U-Pick Farms grows Grapes. The farm is busiest in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Oct in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
